summary: Both REQ-36 and REQ-37 appear to be implemented in the diff. The NavBar in App.tsx now uses the correct nav.getInTouch translation key for the 'Get In Touch' button (fixing raw text rendering), and the translations file includes nav.getInTouch entries for all three languages (en/hi/mr). The mobile hamburger dropdown background has been changed to solid white via inline style backgroundColor '#ffffff', decoupled from the navbar's scroll state. No missing requirements or hallucinated features were identified.
